summary: Toronto Parking Authority’s history goes back nearly 70 years to June 24, 1952 when the Council of the City of Toronto passed a bylaw establishing the Parking Authority of Toronto. Toronto Parking Authority’s use of the Green P logo dates back to at least 1956 and is now a central component of Toronto Parking Authority’s branding of all Toronto Parking Authority parking facilities, parking equipment, the Green P Mobile App, Toronto Parking Authority’s online and social media presence and third-party parking lots operated by Toronto Parking Authority as Green P parking. The use of the Green P Logo has come to be known as an indicator of affordable, safe, and secure public parking in the City of Toronto. The longstanding use of this logo has led to the Toronto Parking Authority’s parking facilities becoming known simply as Green P spaces, lots or garages. Use of the name Green P is so popular with consumers that Toronto Parking Authority actively uses it in its branding. While other parking lots may use logos including a P element, the Green P Logo and use of the colour green in association with parking facilities is recognized by consumers as an indication that a parking lot, garage, or space, is operated and maintained by the Toronto Parking Authority, the City of Toronto’s public parking authority.
